image_description: A collection of vintage and antique smoothing irons displayed on dark wooden shelves against a white wall. The image features multiple instances: two heavy cast-iron 'sad irons' with wooden handles on the top left, a green-painted iron in the center, a flat-top sad iron on the right, and a smaller nickel-plated electric or gas iron on the bottom shelf. The objects exhibit signs of age, including rust and patina.
